entities.summary: Afghanistan is a sovereign nation in South Asia, Asia. Its capital is Kabul. Official languages include Dari (Farsi), Pashto. Government: Islamic Emirate (Taliban de facto government since August 2021; internationally unrecognised). Population: approximately 42.0 million. Area: 652,230 km².
